Summary: Enterprise health tech startup (partnered with three hospital systems) evaluating Redwood for PHI-safe RAG search across clinical notes and imaging reports. Primary asks: scale to ~12M indexed notes (growing 2M/yr), sub-200ms end-to-end p95 for 64-token QA flows, strict audit trail (per-request user id + patient id), and on-prem/VPC deployment with BAA.

Key technical details:
- Indexing scale: initial pilot 2M notes, target full index 12M notes + 40M small attachments (labs, radiology captions). Expected embedding vector count ~14M.
- Throughput/latency targets: 150 qps steady-state for embeddings search; 50ms p50 retrieval target, p95 end-to-end <=200ms with GPU-powered cross-encoder reranker.
- Cost sensitivity: target <$0.03/query average (including retrieval + rerank); want batching/quantization suggestions.
- Architecture preferences: hybrid vector + term index; bi-encoder for candidate recall, cross-encoder reranker for final scoring. Prefer local quantized models for rerank to avoid egressing PHI.
- PHI controls: BAA required, per-request access logs, field-level redaction for opt-out patients, 7+ years retention, KMS/HSM for keys, SSO via Okta and SCIM group sync.
- Networking: VPC peering (AWS), private control plane, strict inbound firewall rules; plan to host inference in customer VPC (on-prem or dedicated cluster).

Recent timeline:
- 2026-01-12: Intro call (AE Lucas) - clinical search pain points, collected basic requirements.
- 2026-02-04: Architecture deep-dive w/ infra + security (SE Aisha) - discussed VPC, audit logs, KMS.
- 2026-02-18: Demo of hosted retrieval + synthetic rerank (recording ff_2026-02-18_73b9). Customer requested cross-encoder latency numbers.
- 2026-02-28: Sent network diagram template + security questionnaire (drive links). Legal submitted initial BAA draft.
- 2026-03-09: Security follow-up — Lacuna infra needs SSO/SCIM test account and Splunk log forwarding stub.

Quotes:
- CTO: "We can't expose PHI outside our VPC; reranker must be local or on dedicated hardware."
- Head of Data: "If Redwood hits p95 <200ms for QA flows at 150 qps, we can move from pilot to procurement."

POC plan (8 weeks):
1) Week 0-1: Onboard security, sign interim NDA/BAA.
2) Week 2-3: Ingest 2M-note sample into private repo, compute embeddings (customer or Redwood-managed in VPC).
3) Week 4-5: Deploy bi-encoder retrieval + small cross-encoder rerank in dedicated cluster; run latency and recall tests.
4) Week 6-7: Integrate SSO, Splunk logging, KMS encryption at rest; run compliance checklist.
5) Week 8: Demo results, ROI/cost-per-query report, recommended config (quantization, batching, caching).
